title: Sapien: A Stateful Policy Engine for Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.00797v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Contextual security defenses prevent AI agents from taking rogue actions by synthesizing a task-specific policy and enforcing it on the agent's tool calls. In multi-step tasks, however, which actions are valid often depends on what the agent has already done and learned. We present Sapien, a policy engine for enforcing stateful contextual policies. A Sapien policy specifies permitted tool-call sequences using a regular expression extended with stateful predicates, deferred policy generation, and scoped semantic checks. We show that Sapien stays within a few percent of an unconstrained agent's utility. Even if the agent is fully hijacked, Sapien's policies rule out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon (twice as many as tool allowlists on long-horizon tasks).

translated_title: Sapien：一个面向自主AI智能体的有状态策略引擎
translated_abstract: 上下文安全防御通过合成任务特定的策略并在智能体的工具调用上加以执行，来防止AI智能体采取恶意行为。然而在多步骤任务中，哪些操作是有效的往往取决于智能体已经执行和学到的内容。我们提出了Sapien，一个用于执行有状态上下文策略的策略引擎。Sapien策略使用扩展了有状态谓词、延迟策略生成和作用域语义检查的正则表达式来指定允许的工具调用序列。我们证明Sapien的效用损失保持在无约束智能体效用的几个百分点以内。即使智能体被完全劫持，Sapien的策略在AgentDojo上能排除93-95%的攻击，在Toolathlon上能排除62-85%的攻击（在长时程任务上是工具白名单效果的两倍）。
tldr: Sapien是一个有状态策略引擎，通过扩展正则表达式指定允许的工具调用序列来执行有状态的上下文安全策略，在几乎不损失智能体效用的情况下，即使智能体被完全劫持也能排除AgentDojo上93-95%和Toolathlon上62-85%的攻击。
en_tdlr: Sapien is a stateful policy engine that enforces contextual security policies by specifying permitted tool-call sequences with extended regular expressions, ruling out 93-95% of attacks on AgentDojo and 62-85% on Toolathlon even when agents are fully hijacked, while keeping agent utility within a few percent of unconstrained performance.
